correctness.rationale: For every n>=3, explicit shortest-path cases show the leaf link is K_{h,h} plus one or two isolated vertices. The simplicial deletion-link cone decomposition gives the homotopy cofiber as its suspension. The bipartite cycle kernel is exactly U_h tensor U_h over Z, with minus-transpose reflection; edge-orbit and reversed-edge midpoint analysis proves the geometric quotient graph is K_h with hanging intervals. An integral block determinant shows the eigensublattice index. The bundled standalone checker reconstructs geodesic triples for 3<=n<=80 and boundary ranks for 3<=n<=23. All-order conclusions are proved symbolically; finite computation is not used as infinite proof.

value.rationale: The induced inclusion GP(C_n) -> GP(T_n) is a natural elementary graph perturbation whose homotopy cofiber records precisely the added topology. The theorem gives a complete all-n two-degree homotopy classification, a parity-sensitive circle rank, and a genuine geometric reflection quotient. Its integral second-homology module is not merely a rational character: the minus-swap eigenspaces have an exact growing 2-power index, a structural obstruction that ordinary Betti numbers and general-position counting polynomials cannot see. This supplies a precise relative invariant for symmetry-sensitive graph modification. It makes no claim that the elementary cone/link principle is new.
